draft.text: You came in because you have been having left arm pain from the elbow to the neck and chest pain that comes and goes.
The chest pain feels like an ache, and the arm pain feels achy and heavy.
You have not had these kinds of symptoms before.
We did not find any specific results from tests or exams during this visit.
Your symptoms could be related to either your heart or muscles and bones.
You will be referred for more tests, such as an electrocardiogram or stress test, to help figure out the cause of your symptoms.

unverified_summary.text: You came in because you have been having pain in your left arm from your elbow up to your neck, and you have had chest pain that comes and goes.
We did not find any specific problems during the exam, but you have no history of similar pain before.
The pain could be related to your heart or to muscles and bones in your body.
You will be referred for more tests, such as an ECG or stress test, to check for possible heart issues.
